name: 缺陷（气孔/缩松/夹渣）分析

map.铸件缺陷分类统计与严重度加权: Classification statistics and severity weighting of casting defects
map.每行输入一条「缺陷类型,数量,权重」，权重按严重度取 1~3（1 轻微、2 一般: Enter one line per 'Defect type, Quantity, Weight', with weight 1-3 by severity (1 minor, 2 moderate, 3 severe). Defect rate = total defects / inspected pieces x 100%; weighted defect index = sum(quantity x weight), for comparing defect severity across casting batches.
map.缺陷数据（每行「缺陷类型,数量,权重」）: Defect data (one line per 'Defect type, Quantity, Weight')
map.📚 深度解析：铸件缺陷统计与严重度加权: 📚 In-depth: Casting Defect Statistics and Severity Weighting
map.铸造车间按批次统计气孔、缩松、夹渣、砂眼等缺陷数量，计算缺陷率与加权严重度指数，: Foundries count blowholes, shrinkage porosity, slag inclusions, sand holes and other defects per batch, computing defect rate and weighted severity index for quality assessment.
map.工艺改进前后对比两批铸件的加权缺陷指数，验证工艺调整是否真正降低了严重缺陷占比。: Compare the weighted defect index of two batches before and after process improvement to verify whether the adjustment truly reduced the share of severe defects.
map.质量工程师在评审会中用加权指数而非单纯数量排序缺陷，避免轻微缺陷淹没严重缺陷信号: Quality engineers rank defects by weighted index rather than raw count in reviews, avoiding severe-defect signals being drowned out by minor ones.
map.检验件数 500，输入「气孔,45,2；缩松,28,3；夹渣,15,2；砂眼,8: Inspected pieces 500, input 'Blowhole,45,2; Shrinkage porosity,28,3; Slag inclusion,15,2; Sand hole,8,1': total defects 96, weighted defect index 212, defect rate 19.20%; both most numerous and highest-weighted is blowhole (90).
map.权重该怎么取？: How should the weight be set?
map.建议按严重度分三档：1 轻微（可修复、不影响性能）、2 一般（需补焊或机加工补救: Three severity tiers suggested: 1 minor (repairable, no effect on performance), 2 moderate (needs weld repair or machining), 3 severe (scrap or affects load-bearing).
map.加权缺陷指数有什么用？: What is the weighted defect index for?
map.它把不同严重度的缺陷折算到同一量纲，便于跨批次、跨产线比较；只看总数会被大量轻微: It converts defects of different severities to a common scale for cross-batch, cross-line comparison; raw totals let many minor defects mask worsening severe ones.
map.缺陷率和加权指数矛盾时看哪个？: When defect rate and weighted index conflict, which to follow?
map.缺陷率反映广度（多少件有问题），加权指数反映深度（问题多严重）；质量决策通常两者: Defect rate reflects breadth (how many pieces are affected), weighted index reflects depth (how severe); quality decisions usually weigh both, prioritizing defect types whose weighted index is rising.
